items.text: Are you a student?
Is your father rich?
alternatives: Is your father a rich man?

items.text: Does he get up early?
Does your sister go to bed early?
alternatives: Does your sister go to sleep early?

items.text: How many people did the police arrest?
The police arrested 15 people, didn't they?
alternatives: The police arrested fifteen people, didn't they?

items.text: Where did the police arrest 15 people?
alternatives: Where did the police arrest fifteen people?

items.text: Why were the police arresting workers?
Why are the police arresting the students?
Why aren't more people doing it?
alternatives: Why aren't more people doing that?

items.text: It is not the end.
It is the beginning of the end.
alternatives: That is the beginning of the end.

items.text: What time did you go to bed last night?
alternatives: What time did you go to sleep last night?

items.text: What time did you get up?
alternatives: What time did you wake up?

items.text: What time did you get to work?
alternatives: What time did you go to work?

items.text: Why did you get home late?
alternatives: Why did you come home late?

items.text: What time did you leave your home?
alternatives: What time did you leave your house?

items.text: Did you take the subway?
Does your mother take the subway?
Do you have breakfast?
